mapper.sql: WITH emp20 AS ( SELECT t.* , f_cdnm('leaveCode' , emp20_leave_cd , emp20_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS emp20_leave_nm , CASE WHEN emp20_leave_cd = '05' THEN (SELECT emp22_reason FROM emp22_etc_leave WHERE emp22_etc_leave_id = emp20_etc_leave_id) ELSE f_cdnm('SpecialLeaveCode', emp20_spc_leave_cd, emp20_company_id, f_sysdate()) END AS emp20_spc_leave_nm FROM ( SELECT emp20_leave_id , emp20_person_id , emp20_company_id , emp20_leave_cd , emp20_reg_date , emp20_start_date , emp20_close_date , emp20_leave_count , emp20_reason , emp20_manager_nm , emp20_emergency_telno , emp20_note , emp20_appr_id , emp20_class_tree_id , emp20_cancel , emp20_spc_leave_cd , emp20_over_confirm_status_cd , emp20_over_confirm_reason , emp20_over_confirmer_id , emp20_over_confirm_date , emp20_etc_leave_id FROM emp20_leave LEFT JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = emp20_appr_id WHERE emp20_person_id = #{personId} UNION ALL SELECT emp24_joint_leave_id AS emp20_leave_id , #{personId} AS emp20_person_id , emp24_company_id AS emp20_company_id , '01' AS emp20_leave_cd , apr01_reg_date AS emp20_reg_date , emp24_start_date AS emp20_start_date , emp24_close_date AS emp20_close_date , f_get_biz_days(emp24_company_id, emp24_start_date, emp24_close_date) AS emp20_leave_count , '[공동연차]'||emp24_reason AS emp20_reason , null AS emp20_manager_nm , null AS emp20_emergency_telno , '[공동연차]'||emp24_reason AS emp20_note , emp24_appr_id AS emp20_appr_id , null AS emp20_class_tree_id , null AS emp20_cancel , null AS emp20_spc_leave_cd , null AS emp20_over_confirm_status_cd , null AS emp20_over_confirm_reason , null AS emp20_over_confirmer_id , null AS emp20_over_confirm_date , null AS emp20_etc_leave_id FROM emp24_joint_leave INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = emp24_appr_id INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = #{personId} WHERE emp24_company_id = emp01_company_id AND apr01_status_cd = '30' /* 상신상태(30:완료) */ AND emp01_hire_date < emp24_start_date AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp28_joint_leave_except WHERE emp28_joint_leave_id = emp24_joint_leave_id AND emp28_person_id = emp01_person_id ) UNION ALL /* AssetERP 시스템 사용전 휴가사용내역 (2023.07.24 CYY)*/ SELECT emp27_leave_old_id AS emp20_leave_id , emp27_person_id AS emp20_person_id , emp27_company_id AS emp20_company_id , emp27_leave_cd AS emp20_leave_cd , emp27_reg_date AS emp20_reg_date , emp27_start_date AS emp20_start_date , emp27_close_date AS emp20_close_date , emp27_leave_count AS emp20_leave_count , '['||emp27_note||']'||CASE WHEN COALESCE(emp27_reason,'') = '' THEN '' ELSE '-'||emp27_reason END AS emp20_reason , null AS emp20_manager_nm , null AS emp20_emergency_telno , '['||emp27_note||']'||CASE WHEN COALESCE(emp27_reason,'') = '' THEN '' ELSE '-'||emp27_reason END AS emp20_note , 0 AS emp20_appr_id , null AS emp20_class_tree_id , null AS emp20_cancel , null AS emp20_spc_leave_cd , null AS emp20_over_confirm_status_cd , null AS emp20_over_confirm_reason , null AS emp20_over_confirmer_id , null AS emp20_over_confirm_date , null AS emp20_etc_leave_id FROM emp27_leave_old WHERE emp27_person_id = #{personId} ) t WHERE ( ( emp20_start_date BETWEEN f_get_close_date(emp20_company_id,#{stdYear},'1') AND f_get_close_date(emp20_company_id,#{stdYear},'2') ) or ( emp20_close_date BETWEEN f_get_close_date(emp20_company_id,#{stdYear},'1') AND f_get_close_date(emp20_company_id,#{stdYear},'2') ) ) ) SELECT a.emp20_leave_id AS leave_id , a.emp20_person_id AS person_id , a.emp20_leave_cd AS leave_code , a.emp20_leave_nm AS leave_name , a.emp20_spc_leave_cd AS spc_leave_code , a.emp20_spc_leave_nm AS spc_leave_name , a.emp20_etc_leave_id AS etc_leave_id , a.emp20_reg_date AS reg_date , a.emp20_start_date AS start_date , a.emp20_close_date AS close_date , a.emp20_leave_count AS leave_count , a.emp20_reason AS reason , a.emp20_manager_nm AS manager_name , a.emp20_emergency_telno AS emergency_telno , a.emp20_note AS note , a.emp20_appr_id AS appr_id , CASE WHEN emp20_appr_id = 0 THEN '30' ELSE COALESCE(apr01_status_cd,'00') END AS appr_status_code , CASE WHEN emp20_appr_id = 0 THEN '해당없음' ELSE f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, emp20_company_id, f_sysdate()) END AS appr_status_name , dcr01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , f_class_tree_nm_allpath(dcr01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_full_name , ( SELECT org.emp01_kor_nm ||' '|| f_get_empTrans(org.emp01_person_id, a.emp20_start_date, 'pos_nm') FROM apr07_alt_appr INNER JOIN emp01_person org ON org.emp01_person_id = apr07_alt_emp_id WHERE apr07_target_emp_id = a.emp20_person_id AND a.emp20_leave_id = apr07_leave_id LIMIT 1 ) AS alt_person_name , a.emp20_cancel AS cancel , a.emp20_over_confirm_status_cd AS over_confirm_status_code , f_cdnm('StatusCode' , emp20_over_confirm_status_cd, emp20_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS over_confirm_status_name , CASE WHEN emp20_over_confirmer_id IS NULL THEN null ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(emp20_over_confirmer_id) END AS over_confirmer_name , COALESCE(TO_CHAR(emp20_over_confirm_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS'), ''::text) AS over_confirm_date_str FROM emp20 a LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = a.emp20_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dcr01_class_tree ON apr01_class_tree_id = dcr01_class_tree_id ORDER BY emp20_start_date DESC, emp20_leave_id
mapper.select: SELECT emp20_leave_id AS leave_id , emp20_person_id AS person_id , emp20_leave_cd AS leave_code , f_cdnm('leaveCode', emp20_leave_cd, emp20_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS leave_name , emp20_spc_leave_cd AS spc_leave_code , CASE WHEN emp20_leave_cd = '05' THEN (SELECT emp22_reason FROM emp22_etc_leave WHERE emp22_etc_leave_id = emp20_etc_leave_id) ELSE f_cdnm('SpecialLeaveCode', emp20_spc_leave_cd, emp20_company_id, f_sysdate()) END AS spc_leave_name , emp20_etc_leave_id AS etc_leave_id , emp20_reg_date AS reg_date , emp20_start_date AS start_date , emp20_close_date AS close_date , emp20_leave_count AS leave_count , emp20_reason AS reason , emp20_manager_nm AS manager_name , emp20_emergency_telno AS emergency_telno , emp20_note AS note , emp20_appr_id AS appr_id , apr01_status_cd AS appr_status_code , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, emp20_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS appr_status_name , dcr01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , f_class_tree_nm_allpath(dcr01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_full_name , ( SELECT emp01_kor_nm ||' '|| f_get_empTrans(emp01_person_id, emp20_start_date, 'pos_nm') FROM apr07_alt_appr INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = apr07_alt_emp_id WHERE apr07_target_emp_id = emp20_person_id AND emp20_leave_id = apr07_leave_id LIMIT 1 ) AS alt_person_name , emp20_cancel AS cancel , emp20_over_confirm_status_cd AS over_confirm_status_code , f_cdnm('StatusCode' , emp20_over_confirm_status_cd, emp20_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS over_confirm_status_name , f_emp_kor_nm(emp20_over_confirmer_id) AS over_confirmer_name , COALESCE(TO_CHAR(emp20_over_confirm_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS'), ''::text) AS over_confirm_date_str FROM emp20_leave LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = emp20_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dcr01_class_tree ON apr01_class_tree_id = dcr01_class_tree_id WHERE emp20_leave_id = #{leaveId} AND emp20_person_id = #{personId} AND emp20_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp20_leave (emp20_leave_id, emp20_company_id, emp20_person_id, emp20_leave_cd, emp20_spc_leave_cd, emp20_etc_leave_id, emp20_reg_date, emp20_start_date, emp20_close_date, emp20_leave_count, emp20_reason, emp20_manager_nm, emp20_emergency_telno, emp20_note, emp20_appr_id, emp20_class_tree_id) VALUES (#{leaveId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{req.leaveCode}, #{req.spcLeaveCode}, #{req.etcLeaveId}, #{req.regDate}, #{req.startDate}, #{req.closeDate}, #{req.leaveCount}, #{req.reason}, #{req.managerName}, #{req.emergencyTelno}, #{req.note}, #{req.apprId}, #{req.classTreeId})
mapper.update: UPDATE emp20_leave SET emp20_leave_cd = #{req.leaveCode}, emp20_spc_leave_cd = #{req.spcLeaveCode}, emp20_etc_leave_id = #{req.etcLeaveId}, emp20_reg_date = #{req.regDate}, emp20_start_date = #{req.startDate}, emp20_close_date = #{req.closeDate}, emp20_leave_count = #{req.leaveCount}, emp20_reason = #{req.reason}, emp20_manager_nm = #{req.managerName}, emp20_emergency_telno = #{req.emergencyTelno}, emp20_note = #{req.note}, emp20_appr_id = #{req.apprId}, emp20_class_tree_id = #{req.classTreeId} WHERE emp20_leave_id = #{leaveId} AND emp20_person_id = #{personId} AND emp20_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.select: SELECT a.total_days AS total_days , a.py_remain_month_days AS py_remain_month_days , a.use_days AS use_days , (a.total_days + a.py_remain_month_days) - a.use_days AS remain_days , to_char(f_get_close_date(a.emp01_company_id,#{stdYear},'1'),'yyyy-mm-dd') || ' ~ ' || to_char(f_get_close_date(a.emp01_company_id,#{stdYear},'2'),'yyyy-mm-dd') AS std_period , etc.total_days AS etc_total_days , etc.use_days AS etc_use_days , etc.remain_days AS etc_remain_days FROM ( SELECT emp01_person.* , CASE WHEN f_get_close_date(emp01_company_id,#{stdYear},'2') < DATE_TRUNC('month', f_today()) THEN f_get_leave_days2(emp01_person_id,#{stdYear},'1',f_get_close_date(emp01_company_id,#{stdYear},'2'),'false') ELSE f_get_leave_days2(emp01_person_id,#{stdYear},'1',f_today(),'false') END AS total_days , f_get_leave_days2(emp01_person_id,#{stdYear},'2',null,'false') AS use_days , CASE WHEN f_get_close_date(emp01_company_id, (#{stdYear}::numeric - 1)::varchar, '2') = f_get_close_date(emp01_company_id, TO_CHAR(COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc,emp01_hire_date),'YYYY'), '2') THEN GREATEST(f_get_leave_days( emp01_person_id , (#{stdYear}::numeric - 1)::varchar , '3' , f_get_close_date(emp01_company_id, (#{stdYear}::numeric - 1)::varchar, '2') , 'true'), 0) ELSE 0 END AS py_remain_month_days FROM emp01_person INNER JOIN emp02_others ON emp02_person_id = emp01_person_id WHERE emp01_person_id = #{personId} ) a CROSS JOIN ( SELECT f_get_leave_days2(emp01_person_id,#{stdYear},'7',f_today(),'false') AS total_days , f_get_leave_days2(emp01_person_id,#{stdYear},'8',null,'false') AS use_days , f_get_leave_days2(emp01_person_id,#{stdYear},'9',null,'false') AS remain_days FROM emp01_person WHERE emp01_person_id = #{personId} ) etc

SELECT emp22_etc_leave_id AS etc_leave_id , emp22_start_date AS start_date , emp22_close_date AS close_date , emp22_days AS days , COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(emp20_leave_count) FROM emp20_leave WHERE emp20_etc_leave_id = emp22_etc_leave_id AND emp20_person_id = #{personId} AND emp20_leave_id != #{leaveId} ),0) AS use_days FROM emp22_etc_leave WHERE emp22_etc_leave_id = #{etcLeaveId} AND emp22_company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT sys09_code AS code , sys09_name AS name FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code a1 ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sys31_leave_company ON ( sys31_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys31_leave_cd = sys09_code ) WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'leaveCode' AND sys09_company_id = 0 AND COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') = 'false' AND sys09_apply_date = ( SELECT MAX(a2.sys09_apply_date) FROM sys09_code a2 WHERE a2.sys09_code_kind_id = a1.sys09_code_kind_id AND a2.sys09_code = a1.sys09_code AND a2.sys09_company_id = a1.sys09_company_id AND a2.sys09_apply_date <= f_today() ) AND COALESCE(sys31_un_use_yn, 'false') != 'true' GROUP BY sys09_code, sys09_name, sys09_seq ORDER BY sys09_seq::NUMERIC

SELECT sys09_code AS code , CONCAT(sys09_name ,CASE WHEN COALESCE(sys31_days::text,'') != '' THEN '('||sys31_days||'일)' ELSE '' END ) AS name FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code a1 ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sys31_leave_company ON ( sys31_company_id = sys09_company_id AND sys31_leave_cd = '04' AND sys31_spc_leave_cd = sys09_code ) WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'SpecialLeaveCode' AND sys09_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') = 'false' AND sys09_apply_date = ( SELECT MAX(a2.sys09_apply_date) FROM sys09_code a2 WHERE a2.sys09_code_kind_id = a1.sys09_code_kind_id AND a2.sys09_code = a1.sys09_code AND a2.sys09_company_id = a1.sys09_company_id AND a2.sys09_apply_date <= f_today() ) AND COALESCE(sys31_un_use_yn, 'false') != 'true' ORDER BY sys09_seq::NUMERIC
